open.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: Sit if you're sitting. Fire's small on purpose. Warden don't come past the fence, but he's got eyes.
Ducks ain't moving. Ducks ain't moved since January. Still, a man sits where he sits.
Twelve-gauge, a thermos, and no decoys out. He's not hunting.

passives.line: No decoys. No blind. He's facing the plant, not the pond. He's keeping watch and calling it hunting.
The firewood's stacked for a week. He isn't going home nights.
Every duck on the pond is facing the same way. Toward the plant. Ducks don't do that.

static.line: He's facing the plant because the plant is facing him. Turn around. Now turn back and don't say what you saw.

options.text: You're facing the plant, Lyle. Not the pond.
(Sit by the fire and say nothing.)

cold.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: Cold night for anything. Coffee's got something in it, you want it.
My wife thinks I'm at my brother's. My brother thinks I'm home. The ducks know where I am.

facing.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: ...Yeah. Since January. Something comes up off that roof at dusk and I want to see it come down. It never comes down.
Goes over the north pond and the ducks go up like a hawk's on 'em. Then they land, and they all face the plant. Every one.
Prey animals face the threat. They know where it went.

facing_fail.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: I'm facing where I'm facing. Pond's that way, plant's that way, I got two eyes.
You want to know what comes off the plant, ask the warden. He'll tell you nothing does, from inside the fence.

sit.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: (He pours a second cup without looking and sets it on the log beside you.)
Most folks talk. You'd be surprised what you see when you don't.
He's been waiting for company that doesn't talk.

hub.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: Say your piece. Ducks ain't listening and I'm barely.

options.text: A kid would've taken the vest. Who leaves orange and stacks cans?
Come into igloo 7 with us. Now.
Two red eyes in the flash, Lyle. It's your vest.
Your brother's going to find out.

cans.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: Not a kid. Kid takes the orange and leaves the cans. This took nothing and left 'em in a row like it was counting.
Twelve cans. I drank twelve. It knew. That's what I can't get past. It counted.
Or a bored game warden with a boot and an evening.
Warden don't go in 7. Ask him why.

cans_fail.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: Kids. Sure. Kids with a ruler.
Go on and look yourself. I ain't going in.

igloo.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: (He stands, and he's older than he looked sitting down. He leaves the gun by the fire. On purpose.)
It don't like guns. I think it don't like 'em. I think it don't care, which is worse.
Door's on the left. I'll go first. If I stop, you stop.
He left the gun. Write that down. He left the gun.

igloo_fail.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: I had a vest in there two years and I ain't fetched it. You go in. You come out and tell me what the wall says.
I'll believe you more than I believe me.

photo.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: (He holds it close to the fire.) That's the tape. Reflective, on the collar. My wife sewed it on in '89.
Yeah. That's two eyes. Two years I thought the eyes was the vest.
Thing is, mister. Tape don't shine without a light on it. And there's no light in 7.
There was a flash. That's the light. ...Though the flash was at the door, and the eyes are at head height.

brother.speaker: tnt_hunter
lines: He knows. Drove out Sunday and sat where you're sitting and said 'Lyle, what are you doing.' And I showed him.
He went home and ain't called since. That's a brother for you.
He saw it. He'll say he didn't. He saw it.
Another witness who'll say he didn't. I could fill a paper with them.
